limitations: Purpose relations are not materialized in world.sqlite; derive_purposes.py writes purpose_ir JSON directly without registering TaskView DERIVED relations.
invoice_contract_link admits only LINKED and UNRESOLVED; no negative link disposition exists in World.
legal_entity_identity admits only SAME_ENTITY and UNRESOLVED in 05_dispositions.json; DISTINCT never appears, so purpose B never emits DISTINCT.
Purpose A acquisition-relevance collapses five contract_term_reading families; UNRESOLVED readings on those families do not qualify a contract and are non-blocking for other families.
Purpose C obligation_kinds lists only PRESENT readings; UNRESOLVED obligation readings yield status unresolved with empty obligation_kinds.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Mechanical projection of source_invoice.status; no epistemic judgment.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: COMPLETE over source_invoice: one row per invoice; is_open true iff status equals 'open'.
derivations.deterministic_computation: SELECT invoice, CASE WHEN status = 'open' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM source_invoice
derivations.required_premise: source_invoice row exists for each billed revenue record in scope.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Filters lifecycle dispositions; does not re-judge active versus expired.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: COMPLETE over source_contract: every contract referent has a lifecycle disposition row; output is contracts with disposition ACTIVE.
derivations.deterministic_computation: SELECT contract FROM contract_lifecycle_status WHERE disposition = 'ACTIVE'
derivations.required_premise: contract_lifecycle_status.disposition is populated for each source contract.
blocking_unresolved_state: contract_lifecycle_status.disposition = UNRESOLVED excludes the contract from active_contract

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Deterministic prefix mapping; no identity judgment.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: COMPLETE union of CRM accounts, distinct billed names, registry rows, and contract referents.
derivations.deterministic_computation: crm:<id>, billing:<billed_name>, registry:<company_number>, contract:<contract_id> from respective source relations
derivations.required_premise: source-native keys present on each source tuple.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Purpose-bound acquisition-relevance gate over PRESENT acquisition term families on active contracts; maps invoice_contract_link LINKED to association asserted and UNRESOLVED to association unresolved. Does not treat missing identity as negative contractual finding.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: INCOMPLETE over represented billed revenue: includes invoices with LINKED or UNRESOLVED ties to active contracts bearing at least one PRESENT acquisition-relevant term; omits non-qualifying invoices and expired-contract-only exposure.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Join source_invoice to invoice_contract_link and source_contract; keep rows where contract is active and has any PRESENT term in {change_of_control_consent_required, termination_on_change_of_control, assignment_consent_or_notice_required, assignment_affiliate_only, assignment_competitor_prohibited}; emit invoice fields plus contract_id and association label.
derivations.required_premise: invoice_contract_link row (LINKED or UNRESOLVED) connecting invoice to an active contract with at least one PRESENT acquisition-relevant contract_term_reading.
derivations.optional_enrichment: legal_entity_identity chains explaining LINKED disposition; not required to emit row when link is UNRESOLVED.
blocking_unresolved_state: contract_lifecycle_status UNRESOLVED or EXPIRED blocks qualification via active_contract
invoice_contract_link absent for an invoice-contract pair blocks inclusion for that pair
non_blocking_unresolved_state: invoice_contract_link UNRESOLVED still includes invoice with association unresolved
contract_term_reading UNRESOLVED on an acquisition family does not assert that family; other PRESENT families may still qualify the contract
legal_entity_identity UNRESOLVED does not block inclusion when invoice_contract_link is LINKED or UNRESOLVED

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Copies legal_entity_identity disposition to epistemic when SAME_ENTITY or DISTINCT; maps any other disposition to UNRESOLVED per purpose negative-inference policy.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: INCOMPLETE over all possible pairs: emits the commercially required link universe already materialized in legal_entity_identity (CRM, billing, contract, candidate registry pairs per relationship).
derivations.deterministic_computation: SELECT left, right, disposition AS epistemic FROM legal_entity_identity ORDER BY left, right
derivations.required_premise: legal_entity_identity row for each required commercially relevant pair.
derivations.optional_enrichment: legal_name_normalization and counterparty_identifier for traceability; not required for epistemic label.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: missing DISTINCT judgments in World means DISTINCT is never emitted

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Conjunctive purpose test: status dependent only when (open invoice OR active auto-renew/rolling contract) AND qualifying obligation kind PRESENT, with confident invoice-contract and counterparty identity joins; otherwise status unresolved.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: INCOMPLETE over counterparties: one row per active contract that plausibly meets dependency conjuncts (current relationship signal and obligation kind PRESENT or UNRESOLVED).
derivations.deterministic_computation: For each active contract with obligation readings: evaluate conjunct_1 from invoice_open+invoice_contract_link or PRESENT auto_renewal/rolling_term; conjunct_2 from PRESENT exclusivity/auto_renewal/rolling_term; resolve counterparty from LINKED billing name or SAME_ENTITY crm link; emit sorted obligation_kinds and open_invoice_ids when dependent.
derivations.required_premise: active_contract membership; contract_term_reading for obligation kinds; invoice_open and invoice_contract_link when open invoices participate.
derivations.optional_enrichment: counterparty_identifier strings; legal_entity_identity for alternate counterparty resolution via crm: when billing link missing.
blocking_unresolved_state: invoice_contract_link UNRESOLVED on an open invoice blocks status dependent
contract_lifecycle_status not ACTIVE blocks the row
contract_term_reading UNRESOLVED on all obligation kinds with none PRESENT blocks status dependent
missing confident counterparty identifier blocks status dependent
non_blocking_unresolved_state: legal_entity_identity UNRESOLVED on non-essential registry pairs does not block dependent when billing-contract link is LINKED
contract_term_reading UNRESOLVED on one obligation kind does not block dependent when another kind is PRESENT
auto_renewal UNRESOLVED on MSA-OAK-2018 does not block dependent when exclusivity and rolling_term are PRESENT
